newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize, soybeans down in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize, soybeans down in slow trade.

text.p: Argentine cash maize and soybeans closed lower in thin physical market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, with buyers dropping bids after falls on foreign markets, traders said.

FAS elevator maize slipped $1 to $105 for delivery to Buenos Aires. FAS elevator soybeans ended $2 lower at $272 for delivery to the port of Rosario. Rosario sunflower seed lost $2 to $218 in thin trade.
